title: Per-agent algorithm selection and fail-stack toggle in forms, scenario editors, agent list and watch screen
purpose: Expose Agent.algorithm_type and the four failstack_* fields wherever an agent is created, edited, listed or watched. The runtime already builds policies from these fields (runtime_core).

modify: abmem/forms.py (AgentForm fields: algorithm_type, failstack_enabled, failstack_limit, failstack_delta, failstack_min_margin, clean() disables fail-stack for baseline algorithms)

abmem/views.py (create_simulation and update_simulation parse algorithm_type and failstack object per agent, get_simulation_status returns algorithm_type name and failstack_enabled per agent, agent_list passes choices)
abmem/templates/pages/simulation-create.html (algorithm select + fail-stack switch with L, delta, m_min inputs per agent row)

public_interfaces.description: (value, label, is_baseline) for every AlgorithmType, rendered from registry.BASELINE_TYPES so the template does not hard-code which types disable the fail-stack switch.

Returns validated {algorithm_type, failstack_enabled, failstack_limit, failstack_delta, failstack_min_margin}. Missing algorithm_type -> DDPG default. Missing failstack -> disabled with model defaults. Baseline + enabled -> validation error 400. Non-numeric or out-of-range values -> 400 with field errors.

ui_contract.algorithm_select: One select per agent with all AlgorithmType labels, default DDPG.
ui_contract.failstack_switch: Checkbox switch next to the select. When on, inputs L (integer >= 1, default 6), delta (TL/MWh >= 0, default 15), m_min (default 0) are visible. When the selected algorithm is a baseline (RANDOM, MARGINAL_COST, FIXED_MARKUP) the switch is disabled and unchecked.
ui_contract.watch_screen: Agent table shows the algorithm label and a fail-stack on/off badge.

invariants: No path saves a baseline agent with failstack_enabled True.
Defaults in the UI equal the model defaults (rendered from the model field defaults, not duplicated in JS).
edge_cases: Fail-stack disabled but values sent: values stored (they keep the user's settings for later), rule inactive.
Existing agents created before 0006: show DDPG and fail-stack off.
test_plan: test_algorithm_selection.py: create scenario with a DDPG agent and a PPO agent (fail-stack on, L = 3), run it with the synchronous starter patch, assert each run agent's runtime_policy class (DDPGAlgorithm, PPOAlgorithm) and FailStackParams (PLAN 2.1 validation). Baseline with fail-stack enabled rejected. Status endpoint returns algorithm and fail-stack fields. Copy test: run agents carry algorithm_type and failstack_* of the scenario agents.
